description: This Java class, StoreBrandingController, is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing store branding settings within an e-commerce admin interface. It handles displaying branding options, saving logo images, updating templates, and removing images for a merchant store.

classes.name: StoreBrandingController
classes.description: Main controller class for store branding management, including display, update, and image removal functionalities.

methods.name: displayStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the store branding page, populating model with store info and templates.

methods.name: saveStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save store branding images (logos).

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the store's template choice.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove the store's logo image.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set menu-related attributes in the model for UI rendering.
